design_philosophy.core: A safe, anonymous, and highly premium space. It should feel like an exclusive nighttime lounge for honest conversations, not a chaotic public square.
rules: No harsh tech blues or pure blacks. Use warm espresso and charcoal bases.
Negative space is mandatory to give emotional weight to personal stories.
Premium features must feel luxurious—use glowing gold/amber tracing beams and blurred frosted glass over locked content.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-First 'Control Room' for feed + Generous Spacing.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, prioritize p-4, p-6 for feed items, gap-6 between posts.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-t border-border).
layout_and_spacing.feed: Max-width wrapper (md:max-w-xl mx-auto) to maintain a focused column layout even on desktop.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid strokes (border-border), no soft drop shadows. Flat and crisp.

feed_post.styling: border-b border-border bg-transparent p-6 flex flex-col gap-3
feed_post.avatar: Abstract generated image, rounded-full w-10 h-10 border border-border
feed_post.actions: flex gap-4 mt-2 text-brand-muted hover:text-brand-accent transition-colors

premium_upsell.description: Paywall entrypoint inside the feed or DMs.
premium_upsell.styling: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-surface_elevated p-8 border border-brand-accent/30 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(230,157,69,0.1)]
premium_upsell.effect: 'Tracing Beam' border effect, or subtle gold radial gradient background.
premium_upsell.button: bg-brand-accent text-[#0B0A09] font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-full hover:bg-accent_hover w-full transition-all

bottom_nav.styling: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B0A09]/80 border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center z-50

create_post.description: Form to write a new anonymous post.
create_post.input: bg-transparent border-none text-xl text-primary placeholder:text-disabled resize-none focus:ring-0

images.description: Use as a subtle overlay or hero background for the Premium Upsell page.
Default anonymous profile picture for Feed Posts.
Alternative anonymous profile picture for DMs or secondary user.
Hero graphic for the Premium subscription modal/screen.

tech_instructions_for_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind CSS and standard Shadcn components. Do not build React Native/Expo code—build a responsive mobile-first React web app.
tech_instructions_for_main_agent.fonts: Import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
tech_instructions_for_main_agent.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (Home, Plus, MessageCircle, User, Lock, Sparkles).
tech_instructions_for_main_agent.interactions: Ensure every clickable element has a distinct hover/active state (e.g., text color change, background tint) and proper 'data-testid' attributes.
tech_instructions_for_main_agent.tailwind_config: Extend colors with the provided palette (e.g., brand-accent, background, surface). Extend fonts.
